main_body: Slate-roofed stall: a blue-grey roof canopy on two wooden posts, with a grey counter holding a blue water basin at the bottom
top_band: Pale grey ridge band at rows 1-3, sloping into the blue-grey roof; counter top is a light grey rim at rows 30-31 around a blue basin at rows 31-35
evidence: The roof reads as a sloped top surface with a light ridge and a dark lower edge at rows 15-17, like the reference stall and well roofs. The counter has a light rim (row 30), then an inset blue basin with a dark inner top edge (rows 31-35), then a grey front face (rows 37-42). The posts are plain vertical supports. A top surface and a front face are both visible, so this is 3/4 and not a front elevation.

style.evidence: The roof has about 4-5 blue-grey steps with vertical tile strips, which is decent. The wooden posts are 4px-wide flat orange strips with only a thin edge line. The counter front is a flat grey block of about 8x6 px with no grain, and the basin is a flat blue with a single highlight bar. The outline is a dark navy-black that leans neutral on the counter and brown on the posts. Beside the reference stall and well, which have tile scallops, stone shading and varied goods, the lower half is flat and sparse, with many tiles of only 2-4 colours.
